stem.text: The number of people P who have installed an app is modeled by the differential equation \( \frac{dP}{dt} = \frac{P}{4} - \frac{P^{2}}{7200} \), where t is measured in weeks, and \( P(0) = 360 \). Without solving the equation, find the limit of P as t increases without bound, and the value of P at which P is growing fastest.

answer_key.label: P approaches \( 1800 \) people as t increases without bound, and P is growing fastest when \( P = 900 \) people.

worked_solution.text: The right side equals \( \frac{1}{4}P\left(1 - \frac{P}{1800}\right) \), which is 0 at P = 0 and at P = 1800, so the carrying capacity is 1800.
worked_solution.rule_named: zeros of the logistic right side

worked_solution.text: For 0 < P < 1800 the right side is positive, and P(0) = 360 lies in that range, so P increases and approaches 1800 people as t increases without bound.
worked_solution.rule_named: sign of the rate gives the limit

worked_solution.text: The right side is a quadratic in P that opens downward with zeros at 0 and 1800, so it is largest halfway between them, at P = 900 people; P passes through that value because it starts below it.

options.label: P approaches \( 360 \) people as t increases without bound, and P is growing fastest when \( P = 900 \) people.
